user.title: Feral File FF1
user.description: The FF1's address on the home network. It asks no login: this integration can do what any phone on the same Wi-Fi can, and nothing that is the owner's alone.

error.cannot_connect: No FF1 answers at this address.
error.invalid_host: An address or a host name, without http:// or a path.
error.not_local: The FF1 answers, but does not see Home Assistant as being on its own network.

abort.already_configured: This FF1 is already set up.

show_playlist.name: Show a playlist
show_playlist.description: Display a playlist: a signed playlist's URL, or a DP-1 playlist built by ff1_playlist.

rotate.name: Rotate the screen
rotate.description: Turn the picture a quarter turn.

clockwise.name: Clockwise
clockwise.description: Off turns it the other way.

set_sleep_schedule.name: Set the sleep schedule
set_sleep_schedule.description: When the screen goes dark and comes back by itself.

set_work_duration.name: Set the time per work
set_work_duration.description: How long each work stays on screen, for every playlist, until changed.

seconds.name: Seconds
seconds.description: 10 to 86400; 0 or empty: each playlist's own timing.

set_framing.name: Set the framing
set_framing.description: Show the whole work with borders, or crop it to fill the screen.
